name: huggingface
description: Connect Hugging Face to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Hugging Face MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Hugging Face to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with models, datasets and papers on the Hub using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Hugging Face workspace.
Find anything in Hugging Face that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review models, datasets and papers on the Hub in Hugging Face.
